caption: The drawing shows a side view of a wheeled carriage with two large wooden spoked wheels colored reddish-brown, connected by a metal axle. The frame of the carriage is black and curves upward at the front and back, forming a concave seat area. The seat's interior is green, with black folded material or cushioning around the back. Two long, thin black handles extend upward and outward from the rear of the carriage. There is also a small brown strap fastened across part of the seat’s edge. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or settings present. The artist’s name, "Alfoso Moreno," is written in small letters to the right of the carriage.
title: Doll Buggy
